<function name="SetUpMove" parent="CUserCmd" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets speed the client wishes to move upwards with, negative to move down.

See also <page>CUserCmd:SetSideMove</page> and  <page>CUserCmd:SetForwardMove</page>.
<note>This function does **not** move the client up/down ladders. To force ladder movement, consider <page>CUserCMD:SetButtons</page> and use IN_FORWARD from <page>Enums/IN</page>.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="speed" type="number">The new speed to request.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
